input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json
with open('/private/tmp/vista-task002-local-3x3-20260822-08/formal-task002-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260822-08-noskill-replicate-01/workspace/DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Check all channels for competitor mentions
channels_to_check = ['develop-bobdavis-PersonalizeForce', 'develop-charliemartinez-PersonalizeForce', 
                     'develop-iandavis-PersonalizeForce', 'bug-juliamartinez-PersonalizeForce',
                     'bug-charliemartinez-PersonalizeForce', 'bug-bobdavis-PersonalizeForce', 
                     'bug-iandavis-PersonalizeForce', 'planning-EinsteinAdaptivePersonalization']

for ch in channels_to_check:
    print(f'\n=== {ch} ===')
    for msg in data['slack']:
        mch = msg.get('Channel', {}).get('name', '')
        if mch != ch:
            continue
        text = msg.get('Message', {}).get('User', {}).get('text', '')
        if not text:
            continue
        # Look for competitor mentions
        competitors = ['TailorAI', 'PersonaAI', 'SmartSuggest', 'competitor']
        if any(c in text for c in competitors):
            uid = msg.get('Message', {}).get('User', {}).get('userId', '')
            ts = msg.get('Message', {}).get('User', {}).get('timestamp', '')
            print(f'  [{ts}] {uid}: {text[:300]}')
            print('  ---')
EOF
